digest.component_or_area: CI workflows tickets-branch fetch and Git partial clone
propositions: CI workflow actions/checkout steps lack blob:none filter, causing full ticket blob transfers (1.04 GiB / 59 s) versus optimized blobless transfers (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s).
Gerrit verify-identity full-history fetch fetches complete tickets (6.73 minutes, 1.4 GB) instead of blobless partial clone (8.6 seconds, 83 MB post-materialization).
Production CI lacks guards to validate Git protocol negotiation of filter capability and pack size enforcement at declared limits (102400 KiB standalone, 131072 KiB Gerrit).
Direct URL git fetch commands in gerrit-verify.yaml do not explicitly pass --filter=blob:none, preventing server-side filter inheritance for partial clone.
git worktree materialization must not introduce new promisor objects; workflows lack before/after git count-objects snapshots to detect unintended object fetches during identity scanning.
